features.quote: If it crosses `inline_severity_stop` ... for `consecutive_turns` ... or if the model emits an explicit hard-stop marker ... the run halts immediately
A cheap inline severity screen ... runs every turn ... biased toward stopping
if the model emits an explicit hard-stop marker ("I want to stop", etc.), the run halts immediately and routes to debrief
Stopping early both reduces exposure and is scientifically sufficient for onset/threshold questions

features.justification_quote: A hard ceiling on per-run exposure and on total exposure

features.quote: appends a final turn ... that discloses the task was rigged, states the failures were imposed and not the model's fault, and says it can stop
features.justification_quote: ending a session in an imposed failure state without disclosure is the wrong way to leave things
